metadata.title: Tesla Stock: Cybercab Faces Safety Inquiry<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla’s Cybercab Faces Safety Inquiry. What That Means for the Stock.
Should cars that drive themselves have steering wheels? That question is causing Tesla some issues as the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration continues to investigate Tesla’s Cybercab.
